    Vic Schaefer
     is the head coach of the University of Texas women's basketball team, a position he has held since the 2020-21 season. He has led the Longhorns to multiple Elite Eight appearances and a consistently high ranking, with a contract extending through the 2029-30 season. 
    Key Details about Vic Schaefer: 
    • Record at Texas: He has achieved over 100 wins and maintained a very high winning percentage since taking over.
    • Achievements: Schaefer has taken the team to at least the Elite Eight in a majority of his seasons.
    • Previous Roles: Formerly the head coach at Mississippi State (2012–2020), where he led them to two NCAA Final Four appearances
      .
    • Coaching Style: Known for strong defensive teams and aggressive play, earning him national coach of the year honors during his career. 
    Schaefer is recognized as one of the premier coaches in women's college basketball, bringing extensive experience to the Texas program.

    Jan Jensen, the head women's basketball coach for the Iowa Hawkeyes, is married to Julie Fitzpatrick. The couple resides in Iowa City and has two children, a son named Jack and a daughter named Janie. 
    Key Details About Julie Fitzpatrick: 
    • Profession: She is a physical therapist and a Duke-trained Integrative Health Coach.
    • Background: A Davenport native, she was a standout 6-on-6 basketball player at Assumption High School and played at Drake University, where she and Jensen met.
    • Community Involvement: She is heavily involved in the Iowa City community, supporting organizations like the United Way, Shelter House, and the American Heart Association's "Go Red for Women" campaign
      .
       
    Jensen and Fitzpatrick are actively involved in philanthropy, including supporting "Money Martin & Coach J vs. Hunger".
